csv_project_name: Consultant for SR 66 Bridge Deck Small Structure
csv_agency: State of IN Department of Transportation
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Indiana , Department of Transportation may be seeking a consultant for SR 66 Bridge Deck Small Structure Replacement , 2 Interchange Modifications at (I 69 and SR 62) and (SR 62 and US 41), 2 Intersection Improvements on SR 66 (Fielding and St. Philip Rds.) and a Small Structure Replacement on SR 66 4.82 miles west of SR 65 in Vanderburg and Posey Counties. This item includes 5 des numbers on 2 construction contracts. R-46729 (2600673 {Lead}, 2600669, and 2600699) and R-46730 (2600671 {Lead} and 2600533). The selected firm will perform the design and plan development work necessary to produce the construction contract documents, and provide services including Environmental Services, Ecological Survey, Applicable Permits, Topographic Survey Data Collection, Road Design, Lighting Design, RW Plan Development, Title Research, Utility coordination, Geotechnical Services, and Construction Phase services. Pavement design will be required for Des 2600673 and Des 2600699. Des 2600533 pavement design may be required if non-standard pavement design. INDOT will provide Real Estate Services and Railroad Coordination for these projects. INDOT will provide pavement design for Des 2600669 and Des 2600671. Please highlight your public involvement strategy. The selected consultant's fee proposal shall be due 45 calendar days after the selection date for this RFP item. These contracts will utilize the INDOT eInvoice application
